name: grill-me
description: Your agent's questions as swipe cards on your phone, end-to-end encrypted. Answers land back in the session.

tools.name: grill_send
tools.description: Ask the user questions as swipe cards on their phone.

tools.name: grill_wait
tools.description: Wait for the user's answers to a grill.

tools.name: grill_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a grill, e.g. when the user answered in chat.

tools.name: grill_finish
tools.description: Finish an idle interview after confirming shared understanding.
